body.x: Textway Inc. (CEO Seungmin Yoo) announced its participation in CES 2025 in Las Vegas, USA, from January 7 to 10 at the K-Startup Pavilion.

Founded in 2022, Textway is a tech startup focused on revolutionizing data management and knowledge organization. Its leadership team combines expertise in technical writing, startup ecosystem development, and AI-driven data technologies. This foundation has enabled the company to develop TaggingBox, an intelligent tagging and search solution tailored for text-based data.

TaggingBox provides AI-powered tag recommendations, a box structure for categorization and storage, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology for precise information searches. These features make it a comprehensive tool for efficient and systematic data organization.

Textway has collaborated with Korea's public institutions, media organizations, and financial institutions to validate its technology. The company has also signed an MOU with Singapore-based Tic-Tag Inc. as a stepping stone to expanding into the Asian market. Additionally, partnerships with companies like Polaris Office have strengthened Textway’s position as a provider of innovative solutions for global markets.

Textway plans to introduce TaggingBox to an international audience at CES 2025. The solution uses AI to analyze user data creation and storage patterns, providing customized tag recommendations that make information organization efficient and intuitive. The box-based structure allows users to categorize data by topic, offering a fast and clear retrieval system. The RAG technology further enhances the tool by delivering accurate, fact-based search results, setting a new standard in data management.

By showcasing TaggingBox, Textway aims to redefine data management for individuals and enterprises, expanding its reach in the global market. A Textway representative stated that CES 2025 provides an ideal platform to demonstrate TaggingBox’s innovative capabilities worldwide while engaging directly with potential customers and partners across various industries. By leveraging this opportunity, Textway seeks to establish a foothold in the global market and highlight the importance of tag-based data management technologies.

The company also plans to focus on Proof of Concept (PoC) projects in the business sector. Based on its successful collaborations with Korean media organizations, Textway intends to target international media companies with customized tag recommendation solutions for journalists.

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
